title: CAI-DLLM: Convergence Aware Inference for Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.22646v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion language models can generate many tokens in parallel, but they still require repeated denoising steps during inference. This makes generation costly, especially when the model continues to recompute tokens that are already stable. To address these limitations, we propose CAI-DLLM, a training-free inference method that uses first-step confidence to guide denoising and reduce inference time. Specifically, CAI-DLLM commits easy tokens earlier, allocates more denoising steps to harder tokens, and adjusts decoding schedules across output blocks. As it relies only on first-step confidence signals, it does not require retraining, extra predictors, or weight updates. We evaluate CAI-DLLM on LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-7B-Instruct across math, code, reasoning, commonsense, and long-context tasks. CAI-DLLM achieves up to 18.2x wall clock inference speedup on LLaDA GSM8K while improving accuracy from 76.27% to 77.41%, and up to 13.1x spee

translated_title: CAI-DLLM：扩散语言模型的收敛感知推理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22646v1 公告类型：新 摘要：扩散语言模型可以并行生成多个令牌，但在推理过程中仍需要重复的去噪步骤。这使得生成成本高昂，尤其是当模型不断重新计算已经稳定的令牌时。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了CAI-DLLM，一种无需训练的推理方法，利用第一步置信度来指导去噪并减少推理时间。具体来说，CAI-DLLM更早地确定简单令牌，将更多的去噪步骤分配给困难令牌，并调整跨输出块的解码调度。由于它仅依赖于第一步置信度信号，因此不需要重新训练、额外的预测器或权重更新。我们在LLaDA-8B-Instruct和Dream-7B-Instruct上评估了CAI-DLLM，涵盖数学、代码、推理、常识和长上下文任务。CAI-DLLM在LLaDA GSM8K上实现了高达18.2倍的墙钟推理加速，同时将准确率从76.27%提高到77.41%，并实现了高达13.1倍的加速。
tldr: CAI-DLLM通过利用第一步置信度信号动态调整去噪步骤，无需重新训练即可显著加速扩散语言模型的推理，同时提升准确性。
en_tdlr: CAI-DLLM accelerates diffusion language model inference by leveraging first-step confidence signals to adaptively adjust denoising steps, achieving significant speedups without retraining while improving accuracy.
